::: {#cor-conditional-as-or}
#### A conditional without the arrow

For propositions $P$ and $Q$, $P \Rightarrow Q \equiv \neg P \lor Q$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"}

::: proof

By double negation (@thm-double-negation),
$P \Rightarrow Q \equiv \neg \neg (P \Rightarrow Q)$.
By @thm-negate-conditional and @thm-substitution,
$\neg \neg (P \Rightarrow Q) \equiv \neg (P \land \neg Q)$.
By De Morgan's law 1 (@thm-de-morgan-logic),
$\neg (P \land \neg Q) \equiv \neg P \lor \neg \neg Q$,
and by double negation again, that is logically equivalent to $\neg P \lor Q$.

:::

:::
